# Flotation

`import metallurgypy.flotation`

Flotation balance and kinetics.

## `FlotationBalance`

```python
class FlotationBalance(feed_mass: Quantity | float, feed_grade: Quantity | float, concentrate_grade: Quantity | float, tailings_grade: Quantity | float, *, mode: CalculationMode | str = CalculationMode.STANDARD, tolerances: Tolerances = Tolerances(rel=1e-09, abs=1e-12)) -> None
```

Concentrate/tailings balance of a flotation circuit from the three grades.

Same equations and domain rules as :class:`TwoProductBalance`; the flotation
wording is: recovery of metal to the concentrate, mass pull (mass yield) and
enrichment ratio.
